Cheren: Why?
Why can't I beat you?{VAR BE01}
OK, let's go.{VAR BE01}

???: Oh!
Why, if it isn't Elesa!{VAR BE01}

???: Aren't festivals grand?
Life should be enjoyed!{VAR BE01}
Cheren: Who is this man?{VAR BE01}

Elesa: This is Alder,
the Unova region's Champion.{VAR BE01}

Hey, you two. Come
here for a moment.{VAR BE01}

Cheren: ...Understood.{VAR BE01}
But, before that...{VAR BE01}

Cheren fully healed 
{VAR 0100 0000}'s Pokémon!
Cheren: OK, let's battle.{VAR BE01}

Alder is so strong!
And he's nice to Pokémon!

I was scared of Pokémon, but Alder
taught me that they're nice and friendly.

Elesa: Let's roll.
The Driftveil Drawbridge is just ahead.{VAR BE01}

Cheren: The Champion is the strongest
of the strong! That's all there is to it.{VAR BE01}
Cheren: This way.{VAR BE01}
Elesa: Now to contact him...{VAR BE01}
Now, watch this!{VAR BE01}

Excuse me!
Please stop right there!{VAR BE01}

A bridge would be meaningless
if no one ever crossed it.{VAR BE01}
Bridges connect the world...
That's as solid as a symbol can get.

Hum fiercely! My battle song!
Battle fiercely! My Pokémon!{VAR BE01}

The Pokémon and the performers
all have amazing moves!

I think being able to make people
smile is a super-awesome talent!{VAR BE01}
That's why Pokémon are so awesome!
Because they can make you smile!

The street performers are my favorites.
They're so charming!
